input: After the application of a form polled: whether its view changed, whether its player plays and the cadence it asks for; once a player exists, a way to hand it a wake.
output: A paint now, a paint later or none: a change paints at once except while the player plays (its new picture wakes the paint at the source rate); the cadence only when this paint had no new picture.
specification: Audit 2026-10-10: the rule lived in the forms' app.rs (Ingest and Story/MA); live 2026-10-08: painting at the screen rate while playing took the graphics card from the HDMI output.
